body:
Varied terrain repeatedly prepares equivalent movement costs inside gradient buckets, while strategic AI distance fields pay for a heap at every relaxation. This prepares immutable cost classes once per swimming profile, deduplicates aliased queue destinations, tightens reservation, and specializes eager fields only after proving uniform cost across every non-forbidden cell. Resumable searches use the same prepared profiles and retain their existing captured snapshots and settlement rules.

Profiling identified strategic AI travel as a dominant mixed-map cost, so its heap is replaced by bounded integer buckets with unchanged wide-distance arithmetic and final rounding. Scalar, SSE2 and NEON paths remain available. Adds independent oracle/lifecycle regression tests, an opt-in paired benchmark and maintained development guidance. No terrain, JavaScript, save, network or simulation-version changes.

Measured results at `37d609766374e7efc1679d643c7d18cde84364ab` versus `3266c8e518a0d40b2100e2e36596822ad74a6f0b`:

- General engine-gradient CPU: **6.0–6.4% lower** across the larger-map real-terrain benchmark aggregate. The **20% research target was not met**.
- Strategic AI travel fields: **66% lower** CPU, measured separately.
- Controlled nearby lazy searches: **8–11% lower** median CPU; this is not a universal lazy-search claim.
- Six whole-game scenarios, **eleven alternating pairs each**, 4,096 total ticks with 512 warmup ticks:

| Whole-game scenario | Median CPU change |
| --- | ---: |
| classic128 | -1.7% |
| classic512 | -1.0% |
| network128 | +0.0% |
| mixed256 | -3.1% |
| mixed512 | -4.9% |
| ice128 | -4.4% |

Negative changes mean faster. Growth is disabled only in the 512² timing scenarios. This is a shared host; paired confidence intervals and every raw sample are in the [measurement report](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/5b94458c281bd5130a6cd721770e13744710c6eb/REPORT.md). Neither classic scenario showed a reproducible regression above 3%; several small whole-game changes remain within measurement uncertainty. No per-cell cache was added: shared metadata totals 1,064 bytes, lazy object size is unchanged, and the measured 512² AI case adds 212 KiB of temporary peak heap. Rejected plane, bitmap and additional-palette experiments remain outside product history.

Validation before master integration: source `478b9b4ba` passes **801 unit cases, 20 focused engine cases and 11 Python contract tests**. The **221-case** benchmark smoke matrix passes normally and under native ASan/UBSan, with independent engine and strategic oracles. The review-polish executable was **byte-identical** to the measured revision after comment/format cleanup; those edits left simulation logic and measured performance unchanged.

The original baseline comparison passed 274 selected engine cases and **57,344 paired simulation ticks** across serial/parallel workers and save continuations, with matching replay/final-save bytes and both 701-tick network goldens. Scalar/SSE2/NEON oracle comparisons passed. ARM64 used QEMU for correctness; real ARM performance and full-engine non-Linux/x86-64 equivalence remain unmeasured. No gameplay behavior change is intended.

Two fresh independent reviewers examined correctness/architecture and tests/documentation. Their findings produced clearer queue/snapshot invariants, explicit eager-specialization regressions, a more readable benchmark, strict option/adapter checks, and protection against overwriting evidence. [Review findings, fixes and refreshed verification](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/8be52d9bbea541c66af90cad6fffbe9fff9acd36/POLISH.md).

[Accessible evidence archive and reproduction instructions](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/5b94458c281bd5130a6cd721770e13744710c6eb) include input maps, source/compiler/dependency/binary hashes, exact commands, profiles, counters, memory tables, raw timing samples, reviews, checksums, replays and saved games.

#787 is merged. Final integration at `785465c5d7b0ef8287fd7c811611d462c403f98b` is based on master `9bfee5aeedac41e12f771f7aa3f05f419fb9a2a1`, including current Trail, Markets V2 and audio changes. Fresh full build, **810 unit cases, 299 focused engine cases, 11 Python contracts and 221 benchmark fixtures** pass. **28,672 paired simulation ticks**, replay/save bytes, serial/parallel runs and both network goldens match. A separately checked uninterrupted/resumed global-checksum bit comes solely from the classic fixture upgrading its map-format header from134 to135; all simulation records are identical. No continuation defect was found. Final accessible integration evidence is linked below. Historical performance measurements above remain attributed to their original revisions; no new timing claim is made for the combined audio build.

[Final integration report and accessible evidence archive](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/a95edb69d35e9a835104f57525d3effcc6fce97d/GRADIENT-INTEGRATION.md). Hosted cheap checks currently fail an inherited audio/browser boundary test in master; both implicated files are byte-identical to master. Failure provenance and logs are included. The local verification above is the accepted merge path under repository policy.

comments.body:
Local / VM verification

- Tested commit SHA: `37d609766374e7efc1679d643c7d18cde84364ab` (source tree `04bc3c80dd723d29f47d12e8f671488e5fb32dba`).
- Base/integration: requested ecology baseline `3266c8e518a0d40b2100e2e36596822ad74a6f0b`, PR head tested. Stacked on #787. Master `e1634ecda` merge-tree is clean; no full combined-master build is claimed.
- Environment: Linux x86-64, AMD Threadripper 2950X, GCC 15.2.0, glibc 2.43; shared host, CPU affinity recorded per run. No hardware counters or host security changes.
- Dependencies/build: `release=1`; frozen baseline/candidate executables, compiler flags and linked/runtime library SHA-256 hashes are retained in the evidence manifests. Patched SDL runtime was used for the native test/continuation suites; both variants use identical dependencies within each comparison.
- Coverage rationale: integer weighted propagation, SIMD aliases, wide AI distances, resumable settlement, snapshot lifetime, paused edits, workspace reuse, queued publication, save/replay/network determinism. Independent authors reviewed arithmetic/SIMD and snapshot/concurrency separately.

Exact native build/test commands (all exit 0):

```sh
GLOB2_SDL3_PREFIX=/tmp/glob2-sdl3/prefix GLOB2_RECORDING_PREFIX=/tmp/glob2-terrain-baseline-build/recording/prefix taskset -c 0-11 scons -j12 release=1 tests build/linux/client/release/src/glob2

LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/glob2-terrain-sdl-patched/prefix/lib python3 test/run_tests.py --binary unit --no-display --exclude-tag benchmark --junit artifacts/gradient-optimization/verified-unit-tests.xml --artifacts artifacts/gradient-optimization/verified-unit-tests > artifacts/gradient-optimization/verified-unit-tests.log 2>&1

LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/glob2-terrain-sdl-patched/prefix/lib taskset -c 2-11 python3 test/run_tests.py --binary engine --no-display --filter '*Gradient*' --filter '*Save*' --filter '*Replay*' --filter '*Terrain*' --filter '*Match*' --filter '*Maxima*' --filter '*Turn*' -j 8 --junit artifacts/gradient-optimization/verified-engine-tests.xml --artifacts artifacts/gradient-optimization/verified-engine-tests > artifacts/gradient-optimization/verified-engine-tests.log 2>&1
```

Results: 800 unit cases passed / 17 skipped; 274 selected engine cases passed / 18 skipped. Full per-case JUnit inventory is retained. Separate final-binary serial/parallel games and continuations compare every tick: 57,344 paired records, byte-identical replays/final saves, and both 701-tick match goldens pass. Standalone scalar/SSE2/NEON comparisons, independent 950-case oracle fuzzing (including expanded future-cost variants) and native ASan/UBSan pass.

Performance confirmation: 529 standalone cases with eleven alternating pairs for each shared/separate layout, plus 66 whole-game pairs. Final timing excludes instrumentation; counters/memory use separate runs. The general-gradient 20% research target was not reached; observed gains and uncertainty are fully reported. A SIGTERM interrupted one game pair; both members of that pair were rerun, preserving all completed pairs.

Omissions/limits: full-engine Windows/macOS/Android/browser/ARM equivalence and real ARM performance were not measured. QEMU establishes tested NEON arithmetic only. Display cases are skipped. Whole-game timing uses serial workers; correctness separately covers parallel workers. Growth is disabled in 512² timing cases; continuation correctness uses ordinary growth. Shared-host noise limits precision. Cheap hosted checks pass but are not engine verification. Parent #787 integration must be refreshed when retargeting to master.

Evidence: [report](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/5b94458c281bd5130a6cd721770e13744710c6eb/REPORT.md), [download/reproduction index](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/5b94458c281bd5130a6cd721770e13744710c6eb). The archive contains 2,458 original evidence files, deduplicated and SHA-256 verified, including saves/replays/per-tick traces and rejected experiments. No evidence artifacts were added to the product branch.

Maintainer acceptance: prepared for review; no merge performed and no maintainer acceptance is presumed.

Independent review and cleanup completed at **`478b9b4bae0aaf177b40c395f44466e8d2aa3152`**.

Two fresh subagents reviewed core correctness/architecture and test/benchmark/documentation quality. No defect in engine results was found. Addressed their findings with:

- Clear cost-class/queue-slot, alias reservation, reverse-entry and snapshot-lifetime explanations; corrected the equal-cost cursor comment.
- Ordinary eager-specialization tests covering differently priced goals, blocked and distant outliers, deferred seeds, caps, thin/rectangular maps and workspace reuse. The distant-road fixture explicitly proves it affects routes.
- Readable benchmark C++ and focused Python helpers; an independent strategic oracle; strict supported-case/size validation; fail-closed instrumentation adapters; preserved evidence directories and visible subprocess diagnostics.
- Eleven fast Python contract tests registered in cheap CI, plus expanded development guidance.

Local verification for this revision: full build exit 0; **801 unit cases passed (17 skipped), 20 focused engine cases passed, 11 Python tests passed**. Normal and ASan/UBSan benchmark smoke runs each passed **221 cases / 1,768 samples**. Twelve invalid CLI cases reject cleanly. Workflow YAML, Python syntax and whitespace checks pass.

Environment remains Linux x86-64/GCC 15.2.0 with the same release flags and dependencies. All four production files have unchanged C++ token streams. The newly built game is byte-identical to the previously profiled executable (`74d14e8c9a22a54c76125bfb664b7c059ebb8c15f8a87fca9910fd5aa5e157b1`), and linked-library hashes are unchanged. Earlier full-game measurements/traces remain attributed to their original revision; no new speed claim is made. Test and benchmark source changes were separately built and checked.

[Accessible review report and evidence archive](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/8be52d9bbea541c66af90cad6fffbe9fff9acd36/POLISH.md) contain exact commands, final source/binary hashes, independent feedback, token comparisons, JUnit results, raw smoke/sanitizer output and CLI diagnostics. Scope is the requested ecology baseline/stacked PR head; no new real-ARM or other full-engine platform coverage is claimed. Existing parent/master integration limits remain. No merge performed.

Final merge validation for `785465c5d7b0ef8287fd7c811611d462c403f98b` against master `9bfee5aeedac41e12f771f7aa3f05f419fb9a2a1` (prerequisite #787 is merged):

- Full native release build; 810 unit cases, 299 focused engine cases, 11 Python contracts and 221 benchmark fixtures passed.
- 28,672 baseline/candidate simulation ticks match, with exact replay/save bytes, serial/parallel equivalence and both 701-tick network goldens.
- Independently checked 24,576 resumed records: all simulation records match uninterrupted runs; the classic global-checksum delta is exactly the legacy map-header upgrade134→135, not a continuation defect.
- Independent rebase/integration review found no blockers. Trail identifiers preserve costs; new queued fixtures cover market and deferred seeds.

[Commands, source/base/toolchain/input/binary hashes, complete logs, traces, saves, replays, diagnostic and limitations](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/a95edb69d35e9a835104f57525d3effcc6fce97d/GRADIENT-INTEGRATION.md). Native integration is Linux/x86-64; prior ARM64/QEMU and sanitizer evidence remains attributed to its original revision. Performance claims likewise remain on their original measured revisions.

Hosted run37334940213 fails the existing audio browser-boundary contract in SoundMixer.cpp. The failing source and test are byte-identical to master, and the failure log/provenance are attached. No new failure is introduced by this PR; per repository policy, focused local validation is accepted despite inherited master failures. No branch-protection bypass or running master-CI cancellation is requested.

title: Accelerate prepared terrain gradients and strategic distance fields
